events.title: Target Early Black Friday Sale
events.basis: Announced by Target (reported by TODAY, Oct 26 2026): a three-day Early Black Friday Sale, Nov 5–7, then new limited-time offers every weekend. Sale-wide discount not stated. One outlet (9to5Toys) reported Dec 7 as the end; two TODAY reports say Nov 7, used here.

source.label: TODAY · Target is kicking off Black Friday early

events.title: Walmart Early Black Friday Deals
events.basis: Announced by Walmart (reported Oct 29 2026): Early Black Friday Deals Nov 12–15, online from 12:01 a.m. ET and in stores from 6 a.m. local. Sale-wide discount not stated.
events.earlyAccess: Walmart+ members: early access to hot Deal drops from 12:01 a.m. ET Nov 12; everyone else from Nov 13.

events.title: Walmart Cyber Monday Deals
